title: v0 vs Replit: Which Is Better for Building in 2026?
summary: v0 generates UI components. Replit is a cloud development environment. They target different problems. Here's an honest comparison — and when Blink is the better choice.
body_markdown: Yes. v0 generates React/Next.js components. You can bring v0 output into your Blink-built application — Blink's apps are Next.js, so the components are compatible. Your database, auth, and hosting come from Blink automatically.
